answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 42600 Country: India Title: Is it permissible to recite Durood aloud on loudspeaker after Azan? Please quote references. Question: Is it permissible to recite Durood aloud on loudspeaker after Azan? Please quote references. Answer ID: 42600 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1695/1695/M=1433) It is not correct method to recite Durood on loudspeaker after Azan, it should be avoided. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
